learningUnits.title: What Is a Program?
learningUnits.content:
A program is a sequence of precise instructions that tells a computer
how to transform input into a required output. Most coding problems can
be understood as Input → Processing → Output. The computer follows the
instructions exactly, so the order and meaning of each instruction
matter.
